metadata.dataset: Curated Amazon Clothing Benchmark (16x20 Research Sample)
metadata.dataset_version: 16x20 Curated Research Slice (based on UCSD He & McAuley WWW 2016 schema)
metadata.citation: R. He, J. McAuley. Ups and downs: Modeling the visual evolution of fashion trends with one-class collaborative filtering. WWW 2016.
metadata.disclaimer: Curated 16-user x 20-item research sample adhering to Julian McAuley's Amazon Clothing 5-core schema. Designed for reproducible, zero-cost CPU demonstration, not the full 278,677 review dataset.
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Curated 16x20 research sample with user-stratified 80/20 train/test split. Test set strictly unobserved during training. Evaluated with Recall@10 and NDCG@10 across seeds [42, 100, 2026].

LightGCN.name: LightGCN (PyTorch)
LightGCN.provenance: Trained PyTorch graph convolution model with BPR pairwise loss on normalized bipartite graph.

MF_SVD.name: Matrix Factorization (Truncated SVD)
MF_SVD.provenance: Analytical rank-4 singular value decomposition on sparse user-item bipartite matrix.

Popularity.name: Popularity Frequency Baseline
Popularity.provenance: Empirical interaction frequency counts on train split.

NGCF.name: Neural Graph Collaborative Filtering (NGCF)
NGCF.note: Theoretical literature simulation benchmark. Not evaluated on current weights.

VBPR.name: Visual Bayesian Personalized Ranking (VBPR)
VBPR.note: Theoretical literature simulation benchmark. Awaiting 4096-d ResNet visual features.
